description: Opaque plum-purple knee-to-calf-length tailored coat over a cream linen undertunic. Broad gold floral-geometric borders run around the high split neckline, front opening, sleeve ends and hem. Several small gold clasps fasten the upper opening; cream inner cuffs show at the wrists. A broad brown leather waist belt carries round gold metal plaques, a large decorated round clasp and a long ornamented hanging strap. Dark brown trousers and tall dark brown leather boots complete the noble outfit. The coat fits a moderately built male frame. No shoulder cloak, headgear, armor or weapon is visible.
